## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format (`<type>(<scope>): <description>`)

- [ ] Tests have been added/updated for new behavior or bug fixes
- [ ] Linting and formatting pass locally (`yarn verify-format`, `yarn verify-markdown`, `yarn verify-spell` if applicable)
- [ ] Build and tests pass (`dotnet build`, `dotnet test` for .NET projects)
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (if applicable)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are included
- [ ] Changes are focused and atomic (one logical change per commit)
